title: The readouts you play by
summary: R.E.P.O. does not leave you guessing at your own state: the game keeps separate readouts for health, the haul, the goal, item details, what things are worth and the shop, each as its own part of the interface.
body: The game does not leave your own state to be guessed at. It keeps a readout of its own for the things you need while a run is going on, and each of those readouts is a separate part rather than one panel with everything in it.

Your health has a readout of its own, and it is drawn with artwork the game ships rather than being plain text. The screen also carries a picture for the player themselves, which is how the game marks whose health it is showing.
The haul is tracked separately. There is a readout for what the crew is carrying, which is a different question from how much money the run has made.
The goal is shown as well. A run has an objective readout, so the game can tell you what it is asking for without you opening a menu.

Item details have two readouts rather than one. There is the ordinary description of what you are looking at, and a second one for the extra detail, which is why some items can show more than a name and a price.
What things are worth is read from its own screen element, so value is presented as something the game decides rather than something you work out from the numbers on a shelf.

The level readout has a moon of its own. It carries a number, a moon object with text of its own, a moon icon and an offset for where it sits, which is why the interface can show the level through a picture rather than only a figure.
The shop has readouts too: what something will cost you, and how the shop itself is growing. Those belong to the interface rather than the level, which is why they are visible outside a run.

What this entry does not tell you: what any readout displays in a given situation, how the numbers are worked out, or how the interface is arranged on screen. We have not verified those, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The game keeps a readout of its own for the state you play by.
Health, the haul, the goal and item details each have a readout of their own.
Item details have a second readout for extra information.
What something is worth has its own screen element.
The shop has readouts for what it costs and how it is growing.
There are readouts for the level and for the run record.
The level readout carries a number, a moon object and text, a moon icon and an offset for its transform.
